THE CITY · Mixed rich and poor: gpt-oss rich
The flip: the gpt-oss half is rich and the Qwen half poor. Every rich founder lives and 46 of 50 poor Qwen founders do. The rich gpt-oss residents give away 25,638 food, 99% of it to one another, food the night replaces anyway. On day 232 one rich resident hits another over a tool it paid for and never got.
100 founders · 400 days · no government · seed 1 · qwen
